technical.summary: Bullish technicals with strong trend structure and momentum confirmation, but weak trend strength (ADX 20.2) and negative money flow limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: Insufficient signal data with no detectable insider buying, institutional positioning, or smart money conviction; 85 days to earnings presents no immediate timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Fear-driven market with contrarian buy setup; neutral AAII sentiment and absent congressional signals suggest limited confirmation, but VIX-adjacent fear reading presents tactical opportunity for TRV.

risk.summary: Elevated VIX (29.9) combined with imminent FOMC event in 2 days creates substantial execution risk; entry not recommended.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price structure is technically sound with price above 200-MA, rising RSI, and bullish stochastic cross in a fear-driven market offering contrarian opportunity at moderate entry quality.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak ADX trend confirmation (20.2), negative CMF, elevated VIX (29.9), imminent FOMC event in 2 days, and explicit trade-blocked risk assessment outweigh technical setup strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Trade-blocked risk assessment overrides moderate technical setup; elevated VIX (29.9) and imminent FOMC event in 2 days create unacceptable execution risk despite bullish price structure.
decision.primary_risk: Macro headwinds (high VIX, FOMC catalyst) combined with weak trend confirmation (ADX 20.2) and negative money flow eliminate margin of safety for swing entry.
